intro.title: Making Hidden Systems Visible
intro.text: The systems around us shape how we live. What we own. What lasts. What powers our lives. How we connect and organise. These are shared questions, open to different perspectives.

paragraphs: Most of the systems that shape our lives were designed by someone. They influence what we own, what we keep, how we use energy, and how we live together.

These are shared questions, but there are no single answers. Creative people have always used tools to change how we see and shape the world. Today, many of the tools and systems surrounding creative work are increasingly built to extract value from it. We bring artists, designers, technologists, researchers and independent thinkers together to question how things work and help shape what comes next.
